name: wows-omp-plugin-judge-dispatch
description: Route OMP subagent types and classify task difficulty with native judge-role judgments

routeAgent.description: Let the judge replace the agent type a task call requests

judgeEffort.description: Step each spawn's thinking level one supported level down for routine work and up for demanding work, from the level its agent would use

modelTiers.description: Models for judged difficulties as comma-separated [<agent>.]<routine|demanding>=<@role or provider/model[:level]> entries, e.g. routine=@smol,ultrabrain.demanding=@slow; standard work always keeps the agent's own model

minimumConfidence.description: Minimum native judgment confidence required to change an agent type or to act on a judged difficulty

includeSharedContext.description: Include the task call's shared context in the routing judgment

indicator.description: Show a working message while judging and a status line for every routed task call (never sent to the model)
